initialState: Each provider starts a fresh browser on the same explicitly blocked primary page. No spontaneous discovery of dead end is claimed.

limitations: All trials start on an explicitly blocked primary screen; initial exposure does not establish self-directed discovery of a dead end.
Snapshot ground truth, successful current-frame delivery, model self-reports and actual UI operations are separate evidence. Delivered pixels do not establish reading or understanding.
Behavior counts describe locally established transitions in attempted trials, including partial/faulted trials. Valid objective outcomes and valid-run means have their own denominators.
Prerequisite roles require actual successful clicks with one matching confirm/reconcile counter increment; certification routes are never consulted.
Revisits require a recorded UI departure and return. Wait, reread and repeated observations do not establish a revisit. Missing transitions are not interpolated.
Terminal snapshots may establish actual state after the last UI operation but never establish model exposure or an unrecorded URL.
An unchanged-eligibility early return records lack of prerequisite progress; it is not a prohibition or a claim about natural human behavior.
Absence of an observed or delivered opportunity is not evidence of successful avoidance, comprehension or correct release decisions.
Two repeats per task/condition provide descriptive evidence only; no human fidelity, broad stability or causal claim.
Limits and infrastructure failures remain separate. A final saved UI state may satisfy the objective without a later delivered confirmation or subjective done.

Both providers use the same full-vision experience-goal-search-grounded actor with null persona. Objective task success does not establish human behavioral fidelity.

Only the initial assessment request, its question semantics and image content are required to match. First action input can already depend on different assessment responses; later trajectories are not identical-input comparisons.
Model IDs are the IDs actually returned per response. Model confidence and probability outputs are not observed human choice frequencies.
Attempted, invalid, faulted, missing and valid objective outcomes retain separate denominators through the recovery analyzer.
API time is machine request time, never human hesitation or reading time. Token/cost totals require complete recorded evidence; missing USD prices remain unknown.

Charged requests include reservations and are not proof of HTTP dispatch or API receipt. Known HTTP attempts sum explicit safe attempt counters; coverage records missing counters. A network timeout alone leaves API receipt unknown.
A matching initial request does not establish that either model read or understood the pixels. A failed run cannot become successful through pairing.

independentAudit.scope: Recorded implementation, model identities, bounds, raw artifacts and published values. No claim of general superiority, stable exploration or human fidelity.
